en-US.author: irwitzer
en-US.description: Create M4A/M4B audiobooks from audio files and CDs, with chapters, metadata and cover art.
en-US.longDescription:
BookStitch is a free, open-source Windows application for turning audio files,
MP3/data CDs and audio CDs into complete AAC-based M4A and M4B audiobooks.
A calm workspace brings together track organization, chapter editing, rich
audiobook metadata, cover artwork and export.

Import and arrange tracks, detect chapters from filenames, tags and embedded
chapter information, and refine chapter titles and timing before export.
The metadata editor supports authors, narrators, series, multiple values,
sorting fields and audiobook identifiers, with source-aware suggestions and
configurable compatibility options for audiobook players. Cover artwork can
be imported from JPEG, PNG or WebP files and prepared for embedding.

Compatible AAC audio can be preserved without unnecessary re-encoding through
an explicit pass-through decision. Other audio can be converted using
selectable mono/stereo presets up to 256 kbps. BookStitch uses FFmpeg and
FFprobe for media analysis and processing.

Drive Circle is an integrated feature for multi-disc projects, coordinating
up to five optical drives. Projects can be saved, resumed and re-exported,
with integrity checks and recovery options for interrupted workflows.
The interface is available in 21 language variants.

Processing stays local, no account is required, and original audio files
are not renamed or overwritten. No advertising, tracking or subscription.
en-US.name: BookStitch
en-US.releaseNotes: BookStitch 2.4.0 includes updates to audiobook creation, chapter editing, metadata handling, and audio processing.
